nodes.question: What type of approaches do complex global challenges lack according to the content?
nodes.answer: Complex global challenges lack simple solutions and require interdisciplinary approaches and new ways of thinking.
nodes.paragraph: These findings suggest that practi- cal engagement in professional communities may effectively foster teachers SSI teaching skills, offering insights for crafting professional development programs in SSI education. Keywords Professional development SSI SSI teaching ENA * Ying-Shao Hsu yshsu@ntnu.edu.tw Wen-Xin Zhang haha1788@gmail.com 1 Graduate Institute of Science Education, National Taiwan Normal University, Taipei, Taiwan Research in Science Education Introduction Recently, the concept of the Anthropocene has been gaining more attention due to the increasing problems or challenges that are significantly influenced by human activities. This concept stresses the enormous impact of human actions on the Earth S systems, prompting a need for global awareness of and collective responsibility for ecological crises (Heikkurinen et al., 2021). To address the Anthropocene challenges, the new PISA 2025 science framework emphasizes the importance of students awareness and concern regarding the interac- tions between science, technology, society, and the environment (OECD, 2023). Con- sidering the inseparability of nature, culture, and politics to which the Anthropocene points, M nster et al. (2023) highlighted the irreversible ecological damage caused by human activities, and proposed that these complex global challenges lack simple solu- tions, requiring interdisciplinary approaches and new ways of thinking.
